title: Infant formula, Gerber Good Start Gentle, Stage 1, ready-to-feed

content.title: About
content.content: Gerber Good Start Gentle is a ready‑to‑feed infant formula for newborns and babies up to 6 months (Stage 1). The formula is based on partially hydrolyzed cow’s milk protein, includes prebiotic GOS and DHA, and is fortified with vitamins and minerals essential for growth and development.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Designed for infants with sensitive digestion and mild protein intolerance.
Contains the prebiotic galacto‑oligosaccharides (GOS) to support healthy gut flora.
Enriched with DHA (docosahexaenoic acid) for brain and eye development.
Free from artificial colors, flavors, and preservatives.
Packaged in a sterile, ready‑to‑use pouch that can be opened without special tools.

items.title: Supports growth and development
items.content: Provides an optimal balance of protein, fat, and carbohydrates, along with essential vitamins (A, D, E, K) and minerals (calcium, iron, zinc) for healthy infant growth.

items.title: Brain and eye health
items.content: DHA is a key component of neuronal membranes and retinal cells, promoting cognitive and visual development.

items.title: Improved digestion
items.content: Partially hydrolyzed protein is easier to digest, and GOS prebiotic encourages growth of beneficial gut bacteria.

items.title: Reduced allergy risk
items.content: Hydrolyzed protein lowers the likelihood of allergic reactions in infants predisposed to food allergies.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Vitamins C and E, together with zinc, help strengthen the infant’s immune system.

items.title: Cow’s milk allergy
items.content: Despite hydrolysis, some infants may still react to milk protein.

items.title: Improper storage
items.content: After opening, the pouch must be refrigerated and used within 48 hours to prevent spoilage.

items.title: Overheating
items.content: The formula is ready‑to‑feed; it should not be heated above 40 °C to avoid degrading sensitive nutrients.

items.title: Not for infants over 6 months
items.content: After six months, transition to a higher‑stage formula is recommended.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Since the product is ready‑to‑feed, simply open the pouch, check for integrity, and offer to the baby. If desired, gently warm to body temperature and test on the wrist before feeding.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place before opening. After opening, keep refrigerated and use within 48 hours. Discard if the pouch is damaged or the formula has an off‑smell.
